verdict.rationale: Puzzle advertises a public API for 'Embedded Accounting' and an MCP setup guide, suggesting some programmatic access, but there is no documentation or evidence establishing that the full range of UI actions (categorization rules, AI Close, reporting, integrations management) is exposed via the API — and probes for an OpenAPI/swagger spec all returned 404, undermining claims of comprehensive API coverage. missing for 10: documented API reference/OpenAPI spec, explicit parity statement between UI and API capabilities, independent confirmation of API completeness.
